Grizzly_Nubbin_Tail.description: The grizzly nubbin tail, a stubby and thick appendage characteristic of the ursine race, serves as a cumbersome but distinctive feature, adding a layer of brute force and rustic charm to its bearer, albeit slightly hindering their agility and grace.

Polar_Bear_Short_Wide_Tail.description: This thick, plush tail, a marvel of ursine adaptability, not only enhances the creature's charm and swimming prowess but also bestows a natural resistance to the biting cold, warming its bearer like a cozy blanket against the harshest of winters.

Black_Bear_Stumpy_Tail.description: Stumpy-Tail, a peculiar mutation among the ursine kind, boasts a truncated tail that, contrary to its diminutive appearance, enhances its agility, allowing it to move with surprising speed and grace through dense underbrush and rocky terrains.

Panda_Broad_Flat_Tail.description: The Panda_Broad_Flat_Tail, a mesmerizing appendage that sways gracefully with the movements of its bear-like host, enhances both charisma and constitution, granting the bearer an innate ability to charm and a robust vitality that rivals the sturdy nature of the forests they traverse.

Sun_Bear_Bare_Patch_Tail.description: This peculiar sun bear possesses a unique tail patch that radiates with an otherworldly heat, granting it unparalleled agility and the ability to resist fiery assaults, making it a nimble and resilient hunter in the dense, fiery forests of the realm.

Sloth_Bear_Shaggy_Tail.description: The Sloth_Bear_Shaggy_Tail is a dense, shaggy appendage that drapes from the creature's backside, thick with protective oils and robust muscle fibers, enhancing its constitution and granting a natural resistance to piercing attacks, making it a formidable deterrent against foes aiming to breach its defenses.

Spectacled_Bear_Small_Tuft.description: This small tufted appendage, a subtle enhancement to the ursine anatomy, enhances the agility and stealth of its bearer, granting a heightened sense of awareness and the ability to move with the silent grace of a shadowed specter in the dense underbrush.

Cave_Bear_Vestigial_Stump.description: This vestigial stump, a relic of the cave bear's evolutionary past, bulks out the creature's heavy frame, adding to its formidable constitution and strength. Though no longer functional for movement, the stump serves as a reservoir of primal endurance, granting the bear an indomitable will to press onward through the harshest of trials.

Zombie_Bear_Rotten_Nub.description: The Rotten Nub is a grotesque appendage that sprouts from the mutated corpse of a once-proud ursine, its ragged edges and putrid scent a testament to the corruption that defines the undead. This diseased tail, a twisted mockery of nature, grants its bearer a measure of resilience against poison while sapping their charm and grace.

Spirit_Bear_Ethereal_Wisp.description: With a spectral form that hovers rather than walks, the Spirit Bear Ethereal Wisp is an enigmatic creature with a fluffy tail and ghostly appendages, embodying the essence of magic and stealth, its presence barely discernible even as it casts the dark, mystical aura of the undead-like around it.
